{{Quote|A precious order passed down by the holy conductors. Rare now to find these old texts, and rarer still to find a bug able to read 'em.
|[[Jubilana]]|Hr=SS}}

<b>Choral Commandments</b> are [[Items_(Silksong)#Tradables|tradable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They carry orders and decrees from [[the Citadel]], and their text can be deciphered after selling them to [[Relic Seeker Scrounge]].


== Use ==
Can be sold to [[Relic Seeker Scrounge]] for {{R|180}}.

After sale, they can be read by visiting Relic Seeker Scrounge, or in the [[Bellhome]] after purchasing the [[Desk]].

== How to Acquire ==
There are a total of four Choral Commandments that can be obtained.

{| class="article-table" style="text-align: center;" width="100%" data-tpt-table-id="choral-commandment"
! 
! Area
! Location
! Map
|-
! 1
| [[Bone Bottom]]
| On a ledge on the east side of the shaft above [[Bone Bottom]]. Accessible from the western edge of [[Mosshome]], behind a breakable wall.
| [[File:Mapshot SS Choral Commandment 01.png|200px|center]]
|-
! 2
| [[Whiteward]]
| Left side of the room. Picking it up leads to getting ambushed by a [[Dreg Husk]].
| [[File:Mapshot SS Choral Commandment 02.png|200px|center]]
|-
! 3
| [[Choral Chambers]]
| Bought from [[Jubilana]] in [[Choral Chambers|Songclave]] for {{R|180}} after completing [[The Lost Merchant]].
| [[File:Mapshot SS Jubilana 01.png|200px|center]]
|-
! 4
| [[Whiteward]]
| Right side of the room among corpses. Requires [[Silk Soar]] or a precise jump with [[Faydown Cloak]]. Access to the right side is hidden by a breakable wall.
| [[File:Mapshot SS Choral Commandment 03.png|200px|center]]
|}

== Trivia ==
* There is [[Cut Content (Silksong)/Text#Items|unused text]] in the game for two Choral Commandments.
** One was a report of the Citadel's [[Memorium]], later replaced by a [[Lore Tablets (Silksong)#Memorium|lore tablet]] in the area.
*: <i>Report of the Memorium and its maintenance.<br>"Containment fails. Memory lost. Excise outer.<br>Maintain inner.<br>Shellwood stasis sustained - Remember.<br>Marrowlands stasis critical - Remember.<br>Verdanian environment exceeded - Destined to forget."</i>
** Another is an issue by the [[Minister]]s addressed to [[the Slab]] that would've originally been found on a Minister corpse in the area.
*:<i>Sentence issued by the Citadel Ministers.<br>"Chosen of the Choir, by grace of our magnanimous Conductors you are granted mercy. When you exit that cage, an elder bug of sins absolved, you may rejoin our flock and feel our light, and never again shall your voice fall silent."</i>
